title: Chick holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloonGrad' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff7b8a'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#e8324a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b81f36'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M44 58 Q48 68 40 76 Q34 84 36 92' stroke='#e6e6f0' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='32' rx='17' ry='20' fill='url(#balloonGrad)'/>
  <path d='M41 51.5 L44 55 L47 51.5 Z' fill='#b81f36'/>
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='24' rx='4.5' ry='6.5' fill='#ffb3bd' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- chick body -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='78' rx='19' ry='17' fill='#ffd54a'/>
  <!-- wing raised toward string -->
  <path d='M47 74 Q38 70 36 63 Q44 64 50 70 Z' fill='#ffc21a'/>
  <path d='M47 74 Q41 72 39 68' stroke='#f0a800' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- wing other side -->
  <path d='M78 75 Q85 76 86 82 Q80 84 76 80 Z' fill='#ffc21a'/>

  <path d='M54 93 L50 97 M54 93 L58 97 M54 93 L54 96' stroke='#ff9e2c' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 93 L66 97 M70 93 L74 97 M70 93 L70 96' stroke='#ff9e2c' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='57' r='15' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- head tuft -->
  <path d='M60 43 Q61 38 65 37 Q63 41 64 43' fill='#ffc21a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='55' r='2.7' fill='#2b2340'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='55' r='2.7' fill='#2b2340'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='54' r='0.9' fill='#fff6d0'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='54' r='0.9' fill='#fff6d0'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M60 61 L68 61 L64 66 Z' fill='#ff8c1a'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='53' cy='61' r='2.4' fill='#ffb199' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='61' r='2.4' fill='#ffb199' opacity='0.9'/>
</svg>
